title: Timeline event
description: One event on the river. File name must be <id>.json (or <Wikidata id>.json for imports).

summary.description: One or two plain sentences. Don't paste text from Wikipedia (licence).

field.description: Which lane of the river it sits in.

end.description: When it ended, for things that lasted a while.

sitelinks.description: How many Wikipedia language editions cover it (from Wikidata). Feeds the importance score.

manualEdits.description: Set to true when you edit an imported file by hand, so the importer never overwrites your change.

conflictingValues.description: Wikidata listed more than one value for this date.
